review: Codex semantic review on 2026-09-15 against the current English sources for feature 418. Reviewed 14 bound labels, 14 bound tooltips, four organelle perimeter tooltips, eight organelle border-alias tooltips, two live bound captions, and Advanced settings help in both source tables. Corrections preserve whole-object arithmetic means in the original own channel and raw units, strict comparisons with equality retained, each bound independently disabled by zero, perimeter-before-filter order, synchronized border aliases, and biological/GUI meanings. This is AI-assisted semantic review, not human native-speaker approval.

records.source: Organelle 1 — Min intensity
records.translation: 细胞器 1 — 最小强度

records.source: Delete organelle objects whose mean pixel intensity in organelle_channel is below this value, measured in the original image's raw units. Equality is retained. Raise it to reject dim objects. Applied after segmentation in both Mask runs and Live Preview. 0 disables this bound. Default 0.
records.translation: 删除平均像素强度严格低于此值的细胞器对象。平均值在该对象自身的 organelle_channel 通道内，对整个对象的所有像素计算，并以原始图像的原始单位表示。平均值恰好等于该值的对象予以保留。提高此下限可排除较暗的对象。在 Mask 运行和实时预览（Live Preview）中，均在分割后应用。0 仅禁用此下限。默认值为 0。

records.source: Organelle 1 — Max intensity
records.translation: 细胞器 1 — 最大强度

records.source: Delete organelle objects whose mean pixel intensity in organelle_channel is above this value, measured in the original image's raw units. Equality is retained. Lower a positive bound to reject more bright objects. Applied after segmentation in both Mask runs and Live Preview. 0 disables this bound. Default 0.
records.translation: 删除平均像素强度严格高于此值的细胞器对象。平均值在该对象自身的 organelle_channel 通道内，对整个对象的所有像素计算，并以原始图像的原始单位表示。平均值恰好等于该值的对象予以保留。降低一个正的上限值，可排除更多明亮对象。在 Mask 运行和实时预览（Live Preview）中，均在分割后应用。0 仅禁用此上限。默认值为 0。

records.source: Merge two touching organelle labels when their shared boundary is at least this fraction of the smaller object's perimeter. Range 0-1; increase it toward 1 to merge only nearly fully fused pairs, or decrease it to merge labels with shorter shared boundaries. Applied before area and mean-intensity filtering in both Mask runs and Live Preview. Default 0 (disabled).
records.translation: 当两个相接触的细胞器标签的共享边界长度，至少达到较小对象周长的这一比例时，将它们合并。范围为 0-1；将此值调高并趋近 1，仅合并几乎完全融合的对象对；调低则可合并共享边界较短的标签。在 Mask 运行和实时预览（Live Preview）中，均在面积筛选和平均强度筛选之前应用。默认值为 0（禁用）。

records.source: Delete organelle labels touching any image edge in both Mask runs and Live Preview. Enabled when either this setting or organelle_remove_border_objects is True; the Live Preview toggle updates both names together. Removes partially imaged objects from area and intensity statistics, at the cost of losing valid objects at the field boundary. Default False.
records.translation: 在 Mask 运行和实时预览（Live Preview）中，删除接触图像任意边缘的细胞器标签。此设置或 organelle_remove_border_objects 中任意一项为 True 时即启用；实时预览开关会同步更新这两个设置名。这样可从面积和强度统计中排除仅部分成像的对象，但也会丢失视野边缘的有效对象。默认值为 False。

records.key: The umbrella over the settings that are one decision applied to several objects — what is done to the pixels before segmentation, which detected objects are kept by area, mean intensity in their own channel and border filters, and whether touching labels are merged by their shared perimeter. Each group is broken down per object, so the same choice for cells and for nuclei sits side by side instead of under two unrelated headings. Nothing here needs touching on a first run.
records.source: The umbrella over the settings that are one decision applied to several objects — what is done to the pixels before segmentation, which detected objects are kept by area, mean intensity in their own channel and border filters, and whether touching labels are merged by their shared perimeter. Each group is broken down per object, so the same choice for cells and for nuclei sits side by side instead of under two unrelated headings. Nothing here needs touching on a first run.
records.translation: 将同一决策应用于多个对象类别的设置总览：分割前如何处理像素；根据面积、各对象自身通道中的平均强度和边缘对象筛选规则，保留哪些检测到的对象；以及是否依据共享边界占周长的比例合并相互接触的标签。各组按对象类别细分，因此细胞和细胞核的同类选项并列显示，而不是放在两个互不相关的标题下。首次运行时，无需调整这里的任何设置。
